Four-direction navigation games—Snake, maze navigation, pellet collection, or pursuit-and-avoidance games—are compatible with this output layer. However, the weights do not supply a distinctive signature separating them. Nor can I confidently rule out paddle or catching games merely because all action columns contain large weights: those weights might cancel or connect to nearly constant hidden activations.

Without knowing the initialization or seeing state-dependent responses, the scattered large entries cannot reliably be separated into meaningful learned features and irrelevant parameters. Naming a particular game here would be speculation.
